service_boundary.intra_hour_check: Under constant hourly forcing and controls, exact first-order RC trajectory is monotone between checked boundary states. This is not sub-hour disturbances/device ramp validation.
service_boundary.reliability_N_minus_one: Not claimed; HP-only reference can be feasible without redundancy under the deterministic design availability assumptions.

comparison_cost_semantics: CAPEX + F*(120-day electricity energy charges + explicitly assumed fixed window OM), F=5 at main four-row comparison; no annualisation. Values exclude unknown costs described below and must retain comparison label.

terms: Actual compatible indoor distribution/terminal cost beyond contract connection boundary
Actual electrical connection/upgrades and account extras/reactive adjustment
Device auxiliaries, water, servicing and complete actual maintenance not demonstrated by quality warranty
Actual tax-credit/settlement treatment outside published gross prices
Replacement, disposal, residual value and physical life
unpriced_boundaries_not_zero.interpretation: Common equal costs would cancel ranking but are not zero or known. Differential excluded costs must modify thresholds; they cannot be asserted equal for an actual project without evidence. Research-budget costs already included do not close real costs.

thresholds.price_axis_method: For each n=0/1/2 compute exact LP optimum affine cost line C_n(P)=b_n+nP; the lower envelope gives all registered package-price decision intervals without fabricating a vendor price range. HP2 has no nonnegative winning price under this declared recurring-budget scenario.
thresholds.correction_equation: HP1 vs no-HP purchase condition: P <= 9346.483316642709 - delta_K - 5*delta_OM. delta terms are additional differential costs outside the declared comparison ledger, unknown for real project.

thresholds.repeat_crossing_scope: Equality of the two fixed F5-optimal plans only; globally reoptimised four-factor table shows HP0 at1/5 andHP1 at12/20. Not an exact universal lifetime/payback threshold.

epsilon_result.compromise_rule: Predeclared middle cap among5 uniformly spaced endpoint CO2 caps; no claim of a normative recommendation or knee. Repeated feasible points are retained.

quality.audit_scope: Independent arithmetic/chronology/physical feasibility under declared equations. Solver dual reports and complete registered enumeration are numerical optimality evidence, not independent proof of LP optimality or field validity.
